The vstd specification of core::hint::unreachable_unchecked, which requires false and never returns.
rationale: The copied const match preserves both Err-arm operations. The Ok arm returns the projected payload, while the precondition eliminates the Err arm and satisfies unreachable_unchecked's precondition.
